testsuite.name: com.kafkasl.phonewhisper.OverlayServiceMeetingModeTransitionRobolectricTest

testcase.name: failed draft persistence during a mode transition keeps the live document and durable checkpoint without installing the incoming note
external Dictation selection saves the edited structured note before detaching the Meeting panel
a newer Meeting choice during Dictation identity restoration reopens the saved document without audio
mode transition during blocked note transfer saves the old edit without installing the stale incoming note
a newer Meeting choice during a blocked transfer restores the current document instead of installing the incoming note
a poisoned Dictation notification after opening a Meeting document does not detach it and it remains copyable
